# CoSky

> Configuration management and service discovery for Spring Cloud microservices, using only Redis as infrastructure.

## Introduction

- [Overview](wiki/guide/index.md): What CoSky is, how it works, when it fits, and where to go next.
- [Getting Started](wiki/guide/getting-started.md): Add configuration and service discovery to a Spring Boot application, then run the dashboard.

## Guides

- [Configuration](wiki/guide/configuration.md): Load configuration from CoSky into Spring, refresh it live, and manage versions, rollback, import and export.
- [Service Discovery](wiki/guide/service-discovery.md): How applications register, stay registered, expire and discover each other, with metadata, status, load balancing and topology.
- [Using the SDK](wiki/guide/sdk.md): Use CoSky's configuration and discovery services directly, without the Spring Cloud starters.

## Operations

- [Deployment](wiki/guide/deployment.md): Run the CoSky REST API server and dashboard with Docker, Kubernetes or as a standalone distribution, and prepare Redis for production.
- [Security](wiki/guide/security.md): Users, roles, the security policy, tokens and the audit log of the CoSky REST API server.
- [Dashboard](wiki/guide/dashboard.md): A tour of the CoSky web dashboard served by the REST API server.
- [Upgrading to 6.0](wiki/guide/upgrade-6.md): Breaking changes in CoSky 6.0 and the steps to upgrade servers and clients from 5.x.

## Reference

- [Configuration Properties](wiki/guide/properties.md): Every property of the CoSky starters and of the REST API server, with defaults.
- [REST API](wiki/guide/rest-api.md): Endpoints of the CoSky REST API server, authentication and error format.
- [Requirements](wiki/guide/requirements.md): The functional and non-functional requirements CoSky meets, each traced to the tests that verify it.

## Concepts

- [Architecture](wiki/guide/architecture.md): CoSky's modules, Redis data model, events and consistency model, and the trade-offs behind them.
- [Performance](wiki/guide/performance.md): How fast CoSky reads and writes, how it was measured, and how to reproduce the benchmarks.

## Contributing

- [Internals](wiki/guide/internals.md): A map of the codebase for contributors, the invariants it protects, and how to debug it.
